Anant Singh Daughter Wedding : anant sinh ne lahraya gamchha...bhir bhi jhum uthi! | Shivangi Singh | Barat
Vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi sinh ki shadi ke lie taiyar kie bhavy pandal men us vakt aphra-taphri mach gaee.. jab vahan phan phailae ek sanp nikal aaya... isi dauran kali ti-shart pahne ek yuvak ne bina kisi suraksha upakran ke nange hathon se sanp ka reskyu kar liya... reskyu ke dauran sanp ne kaee bar yuvak par hamla karne ki koshish ki... is puri ghatna ka vidiyo soshal midiya par vayral ho raha hai
